program.name: stakePool
docs: SPL Stake Pool program instructions; the single byte discriminator is the
StakePoolInstruction enum index and arguments are borsh serialized.
The Sanctum forks (SP12tWFxD9oJsVWNavTTBZvMbA6gkAmxtVgxdqvyvhY,
SPMBzsVUuoHA4Jm6KunbsotaahvVikZs1JyTW6iJvbn) share this instruction interface.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initializes a new StakePool.

accounts.name: stakePool
docs: New stake pool to create

accounts.name: validatorList
docs: Uninitialized validator stake list storage account

accounts.name: reserveStake
docs: Reserve stake account; must be initialized with zero balance and both authorities set to the pool withdraw authority

accounts.name: poolMint
docs: Pool token mint; must have zero supply and be owned by the withdraw authority

accounts.name: managerFeeAccount
docs: Pool account to deposit the generated fee for the manager

accounts.name: depositAuthority
docs: Deposit authority that must sign all deposits; defaults to the derived deposit authority, making deposits permissionless

arguments.name: fee
docs: Fee assessed as percentage of perceived rewards

arguments.name: withdrawalFee
docs: Fee charged per withdrawal as percentage of withdrawal

arguments.name: depositFee
docs: Fee charged per deposit as percentage of deposit

arguments.name: referralFee
docs: Percentage [0-100] of deposit fee that goes to the referrer

arguments.name: maxValidators
docs: Maximum expected number of validators

instructions.name: addValidatorToPool
docs: (Staker only) Adds a stake account delegated to a validator to the pool's list of managed validators.

accounts.name: validatorStakeAccount
docs: Stake account to add to the pool

accounts.name: validatorVoteAccount
docs: Validator this stake account will be delegated to

arguments.name: seed
docs: Optional non-zero u32 seed used for generating the validator stake address

instructions.name: removeValidatorFromPool
docs: (Staker only) Removes a validator from the pool, deactivating its stake.

accounts.name: validatorStakeAccount
docs: Stake account to remove from the pool

accounts.name: transientStakeAccount
docs: Transient stake account, to deactivate if necessary

instructions.name: decreaseValidatorStake
docs: Deprecated since 0.7.0; use decreaseValidatorStakeWithReserve. (Staker only) Decrease active stake on a validator, eventually moving it to the reserve.

accounts.name: validatorStakeAccount
docs: Canonical stake account to split from

accounts.name: transientStakeAccount
docs: Transient stake account to receive the split

arguments.name: lamports
docs: Amount of lamports to split into the transient stake account

arguments.name: transientStakeSeed
docs: Seed used to create the transient stake account

instructions.name: increaseValidatorStake
docs: (Staker only) Increase stake on a validator from the reserve account.

accounts.name: validatorVoteAccount
docs: Validator vote account to delegate to

arguments.name: lamports
docs: Amount of lamports to increase on the given validator

arguments.name: transientStakeSeed
docs: Seed used to create the transient stake account

instructions.name: setPreferredValidator
docs: (Staker only) Set the preferred deposit or withdraw stake account for the stake pool.

arguments.name: validatorType
docs: Affected operation (deposit or withdraw)

arguments.name: validatorVoteAddress
docs: Validator vote account that deposits or withdraws must go through; unset with None

instructions.name: updateValidatorListBalance
docs: Updates balances of validator and transient stake accounts in the pool. Pairs of validator and transient stake accounts follow as remaining accounts.

arguments.name: startIndex
docs: Index to start updating on the validator list

arguments.name: noMerge
docs: If true, do not try merging transient stake accounts into the reserve or validator stake account

instructions.name: updateStakePoolBalance
docs: Updates total pool balance based on balances in the reserve and validator list.

instructions.name: cleanupRemovedValidatorEntries
docs: Cleans up validator stake account entries marked as ReadyForRemoval.

instructions.name: depositStake
docs: Deposit some stake into the pool. The output is a "pool" token representing ownership into the pool. Inputs are converted to the current ratio.

accounts.name: depositAuthority
docs: Stake pool deposit authority; must sign when the pool uses a custom deposit authority

accounts.name: depositStakeAccount
docs: Stake account to join the pool; its withdraw authority must first be set to the stake pool deposit authority

accounts.name: validatorStakeAccount
docs: Validator stake account to merge the deposited stake into

accounts.name: reserveStake
docs: Reserve stake account, to withdraw the rent exempt reserve

accounts.name: destinationPoolAccount
docs: User account to receive pool tokens

accounts.name: referralPoolAccount
docs: Account to receive a portion of pool fee tokens as referral fees

instructions.name: withdrawStake
docs: Withdraw the token from the pool at the current ratio.

accounts.name: splitStakeSource
docs: Validator or reserve stake account to split

accounts.name: destinationStakeAccount
docs: Uninitialized stake account to receive the withdrawal

accounts.name: destinationStakeAuthority
docs: User account to set as the new withdraw authority

accounts.name: transferAuthority
docs: Transfer authority for the pool token account

accounts.name: sourcePoolAccount
docs: User account with pool tokens to burn from

arguments.name: poolTokensIn
docs: Amount of pool tokens to withdraw

instructions.name: setManager
docs: (Manager only) Update manager.

instructions.name: setFee
docs: (Manager only) Update fee.

arguments.name: fee
docs: Type of fee to update and value to update it to

instructions.name: setStaker
docs: (Manager or staker only) Update staker.

accounts.name: setStakerAuthority
docs: Manager or current staker

instructions.name: depositSol
docs: Deposit SOL directly into the pool's reserve account. The output is a "pool" token representing ownership into the pool. Inputs are converted to the current ratio.

accounts.name: reserveStake
docs: Reserve stake account, to deposit SOL into

accounts.name: fundingAccount
docs: Account providing the lamports to be deposited into the pool

accounts.name: destinationPoolAccount
docs: User account to receive pool tokens

accounts.name: referralPoolAccount
docs: Account to receive a portion of the fee as referral fees

accounts.name: solDepositAuthority
docs: Stake pool SOL deposit authority, required when the pool restricts SOL deposits

arguments.name: lamportsIn
docs: Amount of lamports to deposit into the reserve

instructions.name: setFundingAuthority
docs: (Manager only) Update SOL deposit, stake deposit, or SOL withdrawal authority.

accounts.name: newAuthority
docs: New authority pubkey; omit to unset

instructions.name: withdrawSol
docs: Withdraw SOL directly from the pool's reserve account. Fails if the reserve does not have enough SOL.

accounts.name: transferAuthority
docs: Transfer authority for the pool token account

accounts.name: sourcePoolAccount
docs: User account to burn pool tokens from

accounts.name: reserveStake
docs: Reserve stake account, to withdraw SOL from

accounts.name: destinationSystemAccount
docs: System account receiving the lamports from the reserve

accounts.name: solWithdrawAuthority
docs: Stake pool SOL withdraw authority, required when the pool restricts SOL withdrawals

arguments.name: poolTokensIn
docs: Pool tokens to burn in exchange for lamports

instructions.name: createTokenMetadata

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for the creation of the token metadata account

arguments.name: name

arguments.name: symbol
docs: Token symbol, e.g. stkSOL

arguments.name: uri
docs: URI of the uploaded metadata of the spl-token

docs: Fee rate as a ratio: fee = amount * numerator / denominator; 0 denominator means no fee
